_comment: Clicks and what they're called (packages/core/src/step-text/click-naming.ts). Each case is evidence from a real recording, with anything personal taken out, and the naming it must give; a past bug becomes one line here. Element fields left out are UI Automation's blanks.

cases.case: a combo box's own drop-down button is named by its combo box
cases.from: Excel's Number Format drop-down, 10/10/2026 (P5, #92): read once the list had opened, its button said "Close", and the step read Click "Close"

cases.case: a click on a header's filter drop-down opens the filter on that header
cases.from: Excel, 10/10/2026 (P39, #70): the click on A1's filter arrow read Click "Item" from the screenshot, so a reader clicked the cell. Excel says a cell has a filter drop-down (its HasFilterDropdown property), and the press was on the drop-down's square at the cell's bottom right

cases.case: a click elsewhere in a header cell with a filter is a click on the cell
cases.from: the header cell above, clicked away from its drop-down (#70: unchanged)

cases.case: the filter drop-down of a header with no words is named by its cell
cases.from: made up, after the header above: an empty header cell can carry a filter too

cases.case: a button in a combo box with no name keeps its own
cases.from: made up: with nothing to name the list by, its button's name is better than none

cases.case: a lookup that reached only the window is named by the window, not as a control
cases.from: made up, after Chrome on Linux, which keeps pages off the accessibility bus (Phase 10)

cases.case: a lookup that timed out is named by the window
cases.from: made up: a lookup past its 350 ms limit

cases.case: nothing at all to name it by
cases.from: made up: no element and an untitled window

cases.from: made up, after code review (07/10/2026): a click named only by its window has the window as its outline

cases.case: screen words on a menu are its item UI Automation read as it opened: a misread letter
cases.from: Excel's right-click menu, 10/10/2026 (P34, #56): the menu had closed before the click could be read, and the screenshot's words read "Eormat Cells...". The items are the menu's, read when it opened; boxes made up

cases.from: Paint's File menu, 10/10/2026 (P42, #56): Save as was read "Sav"; Save, just above, starts the same. Items as Paint lists them; boxes made up

cases.case: a name UI Automation gave isn't replaced from the menu's items
cases.from: made up, after Paint's File menu read before the click (its pre-read)

cases.case: a click in a pop-up host nothing named is named by the window it came from
cases.from: Paint's File menu, 12/10/2026 (#106): Save clicked at once read `Click in "Pop-upHost"`, its lookup timed out. The window under the press was WinUI's pop-up host, titled in Windows' language (en-GB's "Pop-upHost"), owned by Paint's window

cases.case: a pop-up host's own title never names a click
cases.from: Paint's File menu as #106 found it, in a recording made before the window a pop-up came from was kept

cases.case: a menu's own untitled window is named by the window it came from
cases.from: made up, after Excel's right-click menu (a window of Windows' own menu class, with no title), whose item the lookup couldn't read

cases.case: a pop-up host's title in Windows' language never names a click
cases.from: Paint's File menu (#106) on a French Windows: WinUI's pop-up host is titled as Windows App SDK 2.5 translates "PopupHost" (fr-FR "Hôte contextuel"), which no list of framework names can know

cases.case: a pop-up that draws a title of its own is named by the window it came from too
cases.from: made up: a window without a title bar of Windows' that draws its own, owned by the app's main window. Nothing tells its title from a pop-up host's, translated, and the step is flagged either way

cases.case: a quick click in a WinUI menu, gone by its screenshot, is the item whose box holds it
cases.from: Paint's File menu, 12/10/2026 (#106): Save clicked at once; the menu closed with the click, before its screenshot was checked, so the picture's words can't name it. Its items were read as it opened, in the pop-up host the button went down on. Items as Paint lists them; boxes made up

cases.case: a click in a showing menu with no word at it is the item whose box holds it

cases.case: words read at a click in a WinUI menu pick out its item
cases.from: Paint's File menu (#106), its screenshot taken before the menu closed: the words and the item's box agree

cases.case: a kept menu's box doesn't name a click when the menu may not have shown under it
cases.from: made up, after #106: a menu drawn inside its app's window rather than in a window of its own, so the window under the press doesn't say it still showed

cases.case: a click between a showing menu's items is named by no item
cases.from: made up, after Paint's File menu (#106): a click on the line between two groups of items

cases.case: a click into a Word document's page is a click in the document
cases.from: Word in the test of 10/10/2026 (P38): read Click "Page 1". The page's control type wasn't kept; its parents stop at Word's body, a Document of Word's class _WwG

cases.case: a click on a Word document's body between its pages is a click in the document
cases.from: made up, after the Word case above: the body itself, named after the file

cases.case: a link in a Word document keeps its own name
cases.from: made up, after the Word case above: a link in the text is something to click by name

cases.case: Outlook's message body, in Word's window class, is named as before
cases.from: made up: Outlook writes mail in Word's editor, named for the message rather than a file

cases.case: a click on a clipboard history item never quotes the item
cases.from: #109, made up from the brief: UI Automation names a clipboard history (Win+V) item after the text it holds, so the click read that text. The words on its screenshot are the item's too, should the panel ever show in it

cases.case: an emoji picked from the emoji panel is a click in the input panel too
cases.from: #109, made up: the emoji panel (Win+.) is drawn by the same program as clipboard history, and its windows can't be told apart

cases.case: the input panel Windows 11 shows in a frame of explorer.exe's is the input panel too
cases.from: #109, checked live on build 26300 (12/10/2026): with the emoji panel open over Notepad, the window under the pointer was an untitled ApplicationFrameWindow of explorer.exe's, round the text input host's core window; the element is made up
